headerDisplay: Brings Abode garage doors, door locks, switches, dimmers and bulbs into HomeKit. Consider a dedicated Abode user for Homebridge.
footerDisplay: **Two-factor authentication:** turn on *Use two-factor authentication* and enter your authenticator **setup key** (letters and digits like `JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP`), not the 6-digit code your app shows. See the README for how to get the key.

useMfa.title: Use two-factor authentication
useMfa.description: Turn on if your Abode account asks for an authenticator code when you sign in. Leave off to sign in with just email and password.

mfaSecret.title: 2FA Secret (setup key, NOT the 6-digit code)
mfaSecret.description: The setup key shown when you enabled two-factor authentication in Abode: a long code of letters A-Z and digits 2-7. Do not enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app; it expires after 30 seconds. A full otpauth:// link also works. The plugin generates a fresh code from this key every time it signs in.

exclude.title: Exclude devices
exclude.description: Device names or IDs to leave out of HomeKit.

pollingInterval.title: Polling interval (minutes)
pollingInterval.description: Backup full refresh in addition to Abode's live updates. 0 turns it off.
